blocks.text: RL series circuit mein power asal mein resistor kharch karta hai; inductor energy store karta hai lekin (ideal case, misali halat mein) kharch nahi karta. Resistor ki power:

Yahan I current, R resistance, V voltage aur θ voltage aur current ka phase angle hai. cos θ ko power factor kehte hain. Jab DC power P_dc ko inverter se AC power P_ac mein badalte hain to inverter efficiency (inverter kitni power aage deta hai) ko shamil karna parta hai; yeh aam taur par 85% se 90% hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: 1.5 ton ka AC (air conditioner) ek ghante mein taqreeban 1.2 se 1.5 unit (kWh) bijli kharch karta hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: 575 watt DC wale solar panel se 75% efficiency wale inverter ke zariye kitni AC power milegi?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: 575 W DC solar panel aur 75% efficiency wala inverter ho to AC power kitni milegi?
30 Ω resistance aur 40 Ω inductive reactance wali coil 100 V rms supply se juri hai. Is ki impedance, current aur power factor nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Z = √(30² + 40²) Ω = 50 Ω; Iᵣₘₛ = 100 V / 50 Ω = 2 A; power factor cos θ = R/Z = 30/50 = 0.6 (θ ≈ 53°, voltage current se aage).

items: RL series: Z = √(R² + (ωL)²); voltage current se θ = tan⁻¹(ωL/R) aage.
P = I²R = VI cos θ; cos θ = power factor.
